calculationSteps.name: Base premium times rating factors
calculationSteps.rule: Multiply the product's base monthly premium by the multiplier of the chosen option of every rating factor. Factors apply to the base premium only, never to module prices.

calculationSteps.name: Add modules
calculationSteps.rule: Add the fixed monthly price of every chosen module to the amount from step 1. Module prices are not multiplied by rating factors.

calculationSteps.name: Deductible discount
calculationSteps.rule: Subtract the discount percentage that belongs to the chosen deductible from the amount after step 2 (base, factors and modules together). A deductible of 0 euros gives no discount.

calculationSteps.name: Package discount
calculationSteps.rule: If the customer qualifies for the package discount, subtract the package discount percentage from the amount after step 3. The two discounts compound; they are never added up.

calculationSteps.name: Minimum premium
calculationSteps.rule: If the amount after step 4 is lower than the minimum monthly premium, raise it to the minimum monthly premium. The minimum is a premium before tax.

calculationSteps.name: Insurance tax
calculationSteps.rule: Add insurance tax: multiply the amount after step 5 by (1 + tax percentage / 100). Tax is always calculated on the discounted amount.

calculationSteps.name: Round to cents
calculationSteps.rule: Round the amount after step 6 to whole cents, half up (0.005 rounds to 0.01). Round only here, once, at the end; never round intermediate amounts. Calculate in exact decimals, for example with a decimal type or with whole numbers of cents and percentages: binary floating point stores 9.075 as 9.07499999... and rounds it down to 9.07, where the right premium is 9.08.

orderNotes: Rating factors multiply the base premium only. Adding modules before applying the factors gives a premium that is too high.
The deductible discount and the package discount compound: 5% and 10% together give 14.5% off, not 15%.

The minimum premium is checked after both discounts and before tax. A premium that ends at 1.54 euros is raised to 3.00 euros and then taxed to 3.63 euros per month. Checking the minimum after tax would give 3.00 euros, which is wrong.
Insurance tax is calculated on the discounted amount, never on the gross premium.
Rounding intermediate amounts to cents can move the result by a cent. Keep full precision until step 7.

packageDiscount.name: Package discount
packageDiscount.rule: The customer gets the package discount when they already hold at least 3 active Duinzicht policies at the moment of the calculation.
whatCounts: Only policies with status active count. A policy that is ended, suspended or still being processed does not count.
Every policy counts once, whatever the product. Two policies of the same product count as two.
The policy being calculated does not count: a customer with 2 active policies who adds a third does not get the package discount on that third one.
packageDiscount.appliesTo: Every product that can be quoted online. It applies to the whole amount after the deductible discount, modules included.

rounding.rule: Round once, at the end, to whole cents. 0.005 rounds up to 0.01. Calculate in exact decimals, not in binary floating point: a premium that ends exactly on half a cent, such as 9.075, must round up to 9.08.

ratingFactors.name: Coverage area
ratingFactors.description: Where the customer travels. Europe includes the countries around the Mediterranean Sea and the Canary Islands, Madeira and the Azores.

ratingFactors.name: Household
ratingFactors.description: Who is insured. Everyone insured must live at the policyholder's address. Children count up to and including the age of 26.

ratingFactors.name: Maximum trip duration
ratingFactors.description: The longest single trip that is covered. A trip that lasts longer is not covered at all, not even for the first days.

modules.name: Medical costs abroad
modules.description: Medical costs abroad that the Dutch basic health insurance does not pay, such as the difference with expensive foreign hospitals.

modules.name: Winter sports
modules.description: Skiing and snowboarding on and off marked pistes, including damage to and rental of winter sports gear.

modules.name: Cancellation
modules.description: Reimburses the cost of a booked trip when the customer has to cancel or interrupt it, for example because of illness or the death of a family member. Covers trips up to 3,000 euros per person.

productRules.deductibleAppliesTo: Per claim, for luggage damage only. Emergency assistance and medical costs have no deductible.

ratingFactors.name: Household
ratingFactors.description: Who is insured. Everyone insured must live at the policyholder's address. Children count up to and including the age of 26.

ratingFactors.name: Housing situation
ratingFactors.description: Whether the policyholder owns or rents the home they live in. Owners get cover for conflicts about buying, selling and renovating, which costs more.

ratingFactors.name: Legal cases in the last 5 years
ratingFactors.description: How many legal cases the household had in the last 5 years, with any insurer or without one. Two or more cases cannot be quoted online.

modules.name: Employment and income
modules.description: Conflicts with an employer, about dismissal, salary and reintegration, and with benefit agencies.

modules.name: Traffic
modules.description: Recovering damage after a traffic accident, conflicts about a car, bike or scooter, and criminal cases about traffic offences.

modules.name: Family law and inheritance
modules.description: Conflicts about an inheritance, alimony and parental authority. Divorce itself is not covered. Has a waiting period of 12 months.

modules.name: Tax and assets
modules.description: Conflicts with the tax authority about income tax and conflicts about savings and investments.

productRules.deductibleAppliesTo: Per case, only when an external lawyer is hired. Advice and assistance by Duinzicht's own specialists have no deductible.

ratingFactors.name: Bike type
ratingFactors.description: The type of bike. An e-bike assists up to 25 km/h; a speed pedelec assists up to 45 km/h and has a number plate.

options.label: Cargo bike, with or without electric assistance

ratingFactors.name: Purchase value
ratingFactors.description: The price paid for the bike including fixed accessories, in euros, as on the proof of purchase. Pick the first band whose upper bound is at least the purchase value. Above 8,000 euros the bike cannot be insured online.

ratingFactors.name: Bike age
ratingFactors.description: The age of the bike in whole completed years on the day of the quote, counted from the purchase date: a bike bought 1 year and 11 months ago is 1 year old. A bike older than 3 years cannot be insured.

ratingFactors.name: Theft risk zone
ratingFactors.description: Bike theft risk at the policyholder's home address, decided by the first two digits of the Dutch postcode. A postcode area that is not listed in any zone belongs to the default zone.

modules.name: Accidental damage
modules.description: Damage to the bike from a fall, a collision or vandalism, on top of the theft cover.

modules.name: Roadside assistance
modules.description: Help on the road in the Netherlands after a breakdown or a flat tyre, including transport of the bike and the rider to home or a repair shop.

productRules.deductibleAppliesTo: Per claim, for theft and accidental damage. Roadside assistance has no deductible.
